en-US.author: Luis Pater
en-US.description: Wrap Gemini CLI, ChatGPT Codex as an OpenAI/Gemini/Claude compatible API service, allowing you to enjoy the free Gemini 2.5 Pro, GPT 5 model through API
en-US.longDescription:
A proxy server that provides OpenAI/Gemini/Claude compatible API interfaces for CLI.
It now also supports OpenAI Codex (GPT models) and Claude Code via OAuth.
so you can use local or multi‑account CLI access with OpenAI‑compatible clients and SDKs.
Now, We added the first Chinese provider: Qwen Code.
en-US.name: CLI Proxy API
en-US.releaseNotes:
Linux release assets
- CLIProxyAPI_<version>_linux_<arch>.tar.gz is the default Linux build. It supports dynamic library plugins and is built against a GLIBC 2.17 baseline.
- CLIProxyAPI_<version>_linux_<arch>_no-plugin.tar.gz is the portable Linux build for musl-based or older systems such as OpenWrt. It does not support dynamic library plugins.
FreeBSD release assets
- CLIProxyAPI_<version>_freebsd_aarch64_no-plugin.tar.gz is the FreeBSD arm64 build. It is built without CGO and does not support dynamic library plugins.
Changelog
- fix(codex): release refresh claims on pre-send errors and defer macOS wakes (1f5bf2a5)
- fix(devin): fail over on empty completions and stop fake completion on canceled streams (a9e3ddcf)
- feat(tunnel): add multi-tenant WebSocket data exchange tunnel (/v1/tunnel) (4787c7a3)
- fix(openai-responses): translate typed thinking content-part arrays in responses translator (c3a6c741)
- fix(cmd): return non-zero exit status on config load, TUI, and service startup failures (f93d5cba)
- feat(tunnel): add server type metadata to WebSocket discovery (05fd8197)
- Merge branch 'docs/add-deepsider-sponsor' into dev (9a8ca1b5)
- fix(translator): map upstream MAX_TOKENS to OpenAI finish_reason length (07290e18)
- fix(thinking): validate native responses reasoning efforts (f03f4cd8)
- fix(claude): preserve beta profiles across thread turns (02ec93d0)
- fix(auth): back off rejected refresh recovery jobs (e6317949)
- test(api): verify WebSocket reauthorization with request logging enabled (8e8e8231)
- fix(gemini): preserve thought signatures across tool-call round trips (91aca317)
- feat(models): update Devin catalog and add Gemini model variants (1fcb1432)
- docs(readme): add OriginCoder API provider listing (4cc0cd40)
- docs(readme): link OriginCoder provider name in Chinese README (1cb14ceb)
- feat(tui): migrate management client to v8 routes with legacy fallback (42f9adb9)
Full Changelog: https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI/compare/v8.0.67...v8.0.68
